# Mukunda Infraventures & Projects Pvt. Ltd.

> Plotted development arm of the Mukund Group, Nagpur. Residential and
> industrial plotted communities across the Nagpur region. The group also
> operates in transport, logistics and steel.

## Projects

- Karmabhumi, Mahalgaon, Bhandara Road - 40 acres - industrial plots only
- Ayodhya, Tarodi - 10 acres - residential plots
- Vraj, Jamtha - 7 acres - residential plots
- Dwarka, Sumthana - 15 acres - residential plots
- Keshavam City 9, Wagdhara, Hingna - 7 acres - residential plots - MahaRERA P50500054443
- Keshavam City 10, Wagdhara, Hingna - 6 acres - residential plots
- Govardhan, Khasarmari - 21 acres - coming soon

## What we offer

Gated plotted communities with internal roads, street lighting, water and electrical infrastructure, clubhouse and recreation amenities where stated per project. Karmabhumi offers industrial plots only, not built sheds.
